 Thai & Sushi
 Nestled in the charming town of Irvington, AL, Siam Sushi House invites you to embark on a culinary journey through the vibrant flavors of Thailand and the artistry of sushi. With an inviting atmosphere that blends traditional Thai decor with modern elegance, this restaurant offers a warm and welcoming environment for family dinners, date nights, and special occasions. We serve Sushi, Pad Thai, Crab & Cucumber Salad and Beef Pho. We are located near St. Elmo-Irvington Vol. Fire Station 2. Come join us or order online for carryout today!

 Testimonials
 
 
 
 
 
 ★★★★★
 
 I’m from out of town and so glad to have found this Asian restaurant. We ordered the Bama Roll Spider Roll, Sashimi Deluxe, Lard Nah, papaya salad, and chicken wings for the family to share. The portions were huge and everything was tasty. The service was also excellent and friendly.
-Lam L.

 
 
 
 ★★★★★
 
 Very great place to eat for lunch or dinner. Very nice people and the food is amazing. We had the lard nah and Las Vegas sushi roll with rangoons.
-Jason T.

 
 
 
 ★★★★★
 
 My fav authentic Thai place to eat at! Everything is so fresh & good. You won’t be disappointed
-Isabella S.
